Set up an available answer provider before preparing an assistant action.
The answer provider is configured but availability is unverified. You can prepare the request; nothing is sent until you send or run it.
No maps or browser handler was found. Install or enable a suitable Android app.
This uses an external maps or browser app, which may need internet access. A handoff is not confirmation that navigation started.
Continue in the corresponding Workspace editor. These editing operations are not yet assistant-callable from this catalog.
Image interpretation is checked during attachment review. Adding a photo does not guarantee model support.

Configure OpenRouter credentials in Providers before using grounded web search.
Search is an explicit online operation with source citations and a cost review. It does not silently include the conversation.
Search the web with source citations and a cost review before running.
Source-backed research is disabled in the current task settings.
Set up speech input before starting Voice Mode.
Finish the current reply or recording, then refresh to start Voice Mode.
Create a local note in the existing Workspace editor.
Use the existing image editor in a note or Canvas. Choose a provider and model, then review its cost before generation.
Prepare an investigation using your selected sources. Halo must gather evidence before reporting findings.
Help me investigate a topic using my selected sources. Ask me what I want to research and which sources to use.
Prepare a directions request through the existing Android maps handoff. Halo does not run a local map engine or confirm arrival.
Help me get directions. Ask me for the destination and travel mode before requesting a maps handoff.
Open your saved notes, conversations and sources.
Capture a note, photo, file or voice memo using the existing local Inbox.
Open Workspace and choose a Canvas to arrange saved sources and images.
Open existing study sessions or choose material for a grounded explanation.
Choose a photo or exact selection to review. Support depends on the selected vision model and sharing settings.
Open saved files in Workspace. Readable text and images can be attached; PDF pages use Study. Other formats remain saved files.
In development. A verified calculation tool is not connected to this catalog.

Choose a duration and review the request before running it through Halo. The Android clock app controls the final timer.
Prepare an app-opening request through the existing phone action pipeline.
Review configured connections and the tools they actually provide.
Start or end Voice Mode using your configured speech and answer settings.
Replay the last available voice reply bound to this conversation.
Save a selected file, then choose how to use it. PDF pages stay in Study.
Record or save audio in Inbox. It is not automatically transcribed or attached.
Use the existing screen capture or Ink selection actions to send an exact source to Home. No region is inferred here. Review current selected sources in the attachment sheet.
To use PDF pages, open the saved file in Study.
The source is saved locally. It is not attached to this chat until you choose Attach.
The PDF is saved locally. Open Study to choose its pages; it is not attached to this chat.
The audio is saved locally. It has not been transcribed or attached to this chat.
The file is saved locally. This format is not supported as chat context.
